description: A formal exterior walkway and reflecting pool garden photographed at standing eye-level with a one-point perspective composition, the camera perfectly centered on the path's axis looking straight ahead toward a distant architectural pavilion. The pathway is a broad boardwalk of dark weathered hardwood decking planks running straight through the center of the frame, flanked on either side by two long shallow reflecting pools with dark still water. The left boundary is a tall raw board-formed concrete wall with horizontal plank impressions, and at the far left edge dark evergreen conifer trees rise above the wall into the dusky blue sky. On the right, the exterior of a building clad in vertical dark stained cedar or redwood slat cladding creates a warm mahogany-toned architectural wall. At the far end, a traditional Japanese-influenced open pavilion with a pitched roof and vertical slatted screen infill closes the perspective. Six square lantern-style ground post elements are arranged symmetrically — three on each side of the walkway — positioned on the coping edge of the reflecting pools, each glowing with a warm amber interior illumination and reflecting their glow perfectly in the water surface. The palette is deep grey-blue twilight sky, dark warm cedar wood, raw concrete, reflective black water, warm amber lantern glow, and dark decking. The mood is serene, meditative, and architecturally rigorous.
